route: txflow BTC-USDC x Lighter Core BTC
source_clock: TxFlow time is documented milliseconds; Lighter last_updated_at is assumed microseconds and is unverified. Venue clock synchronization is unknown.

contracts.txflow_multiplier: 1 underlying unit per official contract specification
contracts.lighter_multiplier: metadata says 1, but official semantic, settlement, and cross-venue conversion remain UNVERIFIED
contracts.hedge_ratio: 1:1 BTC assumed only for hypothetical replay
contracts.units: USDC quote on TxFlow; Lighter quote/conversion interpretation UNVERIFIED

fees: Research assumptions: both venues 0bps, then TxFlow taker 4.5bps and Lighter 0bps; rewards excluded.
limitations: Same symbol does not establish identical index or contract economics.
PnL and size assume a common USDC-equivalent quote and 1:1 BTC size; neither conversion nor economic compatibility is verified.
Event-driven mode uses only received book events; quote freshness is reevaluated at decisions.
Capture gaps do not bridge positions across Capture boundaries.
Holdout results are descriptive and independent only when the Capture is labeled holdout.
